_comment: YAGPDB all-in-one (Postgres + Redis + bot) for Pterodactyl.
name: YAGPDB (All-in-One)
author: tomwbloomer@gmail.com
description: Yet Another General Purpose Discord Bot, self-hosted. Bundles PostgreSQL, Redis and the bot in one container via supervisord. Requires a reverse proxy with TLS in front for Discord OAuth.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo 'YAGPDB image is self-contained; nothing to install.'

variables.name: Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token from the Bot tab of your application. Include the 'Bot ' prefix, e.g. 'Bot MTIz...'.

variables.name: Client ID
variables.description: Application (client) ID from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Client Secret
variables.description: OAuth2 client secret from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Your Discord user ID (enables owner-only bot controls).

variables.name: Host
variables.description: Public domain that points to this server (e.g. yagpdb.example.com). Must match the OAuth2 redirect in your Discord app and be served over HTTPS by your reverse proxy.
